name: browser-use
headline: Notification Skill: Task Alerts for AI Agents
short_description: Send push notifications via Bark or email when Agent tasks complete or when you need to alert users across multiple devices.
author: caopulan

sections.overview:
Notification Skill enables AI agents like Claude and Cursor to send push notifications upon task completion or user alerts. It supports Bark for iOS devices and email for any device, allowing you to stay informed about agent activity across your machines. The skill includes multi-device naming to distinguish between different environments and requires minimal setup—just install, configure environment variables, and update your AGENTS.md file. Use it to receive instant notifications when long-running tasks finish or to alert multiple team members via email.
Receive Bark notifications on iPhone when Agent tasks finish
Alert multiple team members via email about task completion
Monitor Agent activity across multiple machines with device naming
Get instant notifications for long-running Agent processes
GreenTech Solutions, a renewable energy company, needs a robust notification system to monitor its solar panel performance data. The system will track energy output, system errors, and maintenance schedules, sending alerts via email, SMS, and push notifications.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/caopulan/Notification-Skill`
sections.usage:
```
Create a notification system for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The system should monitor [DATA] and send alerts when specific conditions are met. Include details about the notification channels (email, SMS, push notifications) and the frequency of alerts. Also, provide a sample alert message.
```
